note: Deterministic classification of inventory paths. Ordered rules, first match wins. A path that matches nothing stays `unclassified` and is NOT given a zero weight - an unclassified money path is not a harmless one. Weights are a convention, recorded by digest in every verdict that uses them (round 7, review 4: never let a model invent weights).

money.why: moving value is the canonical irreversible act

personal_data.why: irreversible disclosure, regulated in most jurisdictions

files.why: readable payload, usually reversible by access revocation

other.why: state that changes without an obvious external consequence

unclassified.why: unknown class is treated as materially risky, never as zero

thresholds.note: Fraction of known weighted risk that exists OUTSIDE the core. Above this, an upgrade to SCOPED_ASSURANCE or PROVEN is refused regardless of core coverage.
